description: This file contains C source code implementing a PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) entity with functions for importing/exporting PKCS12 certificates, creating self-signed certificates, setting issued PKCS7 certificates, and related cryptographic operations. It is auto-generated by Cisco systems and includes detailed functions for certificate handling within a PKI framework.

classes.name: PPKI_CLIENT_ENTITY
classes.description: Pointer to a PKI client entity structure representing a PKI entity and associated functions for certificate management.

classes.name: PALCERT_CONTEXT
classes.description: Pointer to a certificate context structure used for managing trusted CAs and certificate store.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS initProc(ANSC_HANDLE hContext,PUCHAR pCertEncoding,ULONG ulCertSize,PUCHAR pKeyEncoding,ULONG ulKeyInfoSize)
methods.description: Callback function to process certificate and key info from PKCS12 during import, adding trusted CA certificates or setting issued certificates.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AdvPKIEntityImportPKCS12(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pPKCS12Encoding,ULONG length,PCHAR pPassword)
methods.description: Function to import a PKCS12 encoded certificate bundle, decrypting and verifying the certificate contents using a password.

methods.name: PUCHAR AdvPKIEntityExportPKCS12Encoding(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PCHAR pPass,BOOLEAN bExportCA,PULONG pLength)
methods.description: Exports the PKI entity's certificate and private key as a PKCS12 encoded blob with encryption, suitable for storage or transfer.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AdvPKIEntityExportPKCS12Handle(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PCHAR pPassword,BOOLEAN bExportCA)
methods.description: Prepares a PKCS12 handle with certificates and keys for export, optionally including trusted CA certificates.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AdvPKIEntityCreateSelfSignedCert(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOLEAN bHasKeyIdentifier)
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate for the entity, either via internal cryptographic API or Windows CryptoAPI.

methods.name: PUCHAR AdvPKIEntityCreateSelfSignedCertEncoding(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOLEAN bHasKeyIdentifier,PULONG pLength)
methods.description: Generates and encodes a self-signed certificate, returning the encoded buffer along with its length.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AdvPKIEntitySetIssuedPKCS7Certs(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pEncoding,ULONG length)
methods.description: Sets the issued PKCS7 certificates from a given ASN.1 encoded bundle, updating the internal certificate store.
